Topic/goal/plan-type exploration over adopted public plan sources only.

Cited likely permit pathway, attachments and timeline; informational only.

``use_model_assistance`` does not exist here: the resident live-model
assistance flag (F-07) stays excluded, so only the deterministic cited
pathway is reachable from the shared shell.

get.description: The media types this deployment's product model actually accepts.

post.description:
Run the configured adapters over retained originals; draft only.

The result carries the same observations/citations the product route returns
plus ``analysis_record``: the exact ``AnalysisRecord`` the caller puts on its
case payload, so the reviewed draft is the analysed one.

ModelRegistryRead.description:
Schema for returning a model_registry record (GET response).

ModelRegistryUpdate.description:

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Active portal posture for this deployment. ``public`` = minimal resident surface (landing + authenticated records-request submission + resident registration) reachable without staff auth. ``private`` = staff-only; no public routes, no resident self-registration.

PortalModeResponse.title: PortalModeResponse
PortalModeResponse.description:
T5D — schema for ``GET /config/portal-mode``.

Exposed to the frontend on boot so it can branch routing without a
user-identity lookup. The payload is intentionally the single field
below — no staff config, no user state, no schema version.

TestConnectionRequest.title: TestConnectionRequest
TestConnectionRequest.description:
Dedicated schema for test-connection. NOT the create schema.

Security: credentials in this request body are never persisted, never
written to audit logs, and never returned in the response.

UserSelfUpdate.title: UserSelfUpdate
UserSelfUpdate.description:
Schema for user self-update via PATCH /users/me.

Excludes role and department_id. Any payload containing those fields is
rejected at parse time (HTTP 422). Role and department changes require
admin privileges via /admin/users/{id}.
